family: steady heat conduction with convection (2D fin)
prompt:
Thin aluminium cooling fin: an L-shaped plate in the x-y plane made of the rectangles 0 <= x <= 100, 0 <= y <= 40 mm and 0 <= x <= 40, 0 <= y <= 100 mm (arms 40 mm wide), thickness 2 mm, thermal conductivity 200 W/(m K). The whole edge x = 0 (0 <= y <= 100 mm) is held at 100 C. Every other edge and both large faces lose heat by convection, h = 25 W/(m^2 K), to air at 20 C. Steady state; temperature uniform through the thickness. Report the heat flow entering through the edge x = 0 and the lowest temperature in the fin.
JSON keys: heat_flow_W, min_temperature_C.
